title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Payables: Cash Settlements, Payout Issue and Charge Payments
content:
**Cash in place of repair.** In place of repairing a covered non-structural item, Calloway may offer a cash settlement of no more than the program's cash-in-lieu maximum per claim item under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty. The settlement becomes a payout only when the homeowner accepts it in writing, and the item is then closed without repair.

**Issue of payouts.** Approved payouts are issued within the program's payout issue business days, one issue entry per payout number. An approved payout not yet paid stands among the payouts Calloway owes the homeowner on the coverage until it is issued.

**Payment of charges.** Homeowner charges are paid by card or by ACH, each payment naming the charge number it pays. Charges not yet paid or waived stand among the warranty charges the homeowner owes. An open charge does not stop Calloway from handling claims.

| Matter | Rule |
|---|---|
| Items eligible for a cash settlement | Covered non-structural items |
| Most that may be offered | The program's cash-in-lieu maximum, per claim item |
| When the offer becomes a payout | Only on the homeowner's written acceptance |
| Effect on the item | Closed without repair |
| Issue | Within the program's payout issue business days; one issue entry per payout number |
| Charge payment methods | Card or ACH, naming the charge number paid |
| Effect of an unpaid charge on claims | None; claims continue to be handled |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A homeowner with an unpaid reinspection charge reports a new plumbing item; the open charge does not hold up the handling of the new item.
